Incredible.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]To think this was all rubble not[XENO:n ]
so long ago.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]That it was. The reconstruction[XENO:n ]
is progressing very rapidly indeed.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And the population is growing[XENO:n ]
day by day.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]It just goes to show...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]People can achieve anything when[XENO:n ]
they really work together.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Teamwork can fell insurmountable[XENO:n ]
obstacles.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Looking back on the[XENO:n ]
Battle of Sword Valley...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Well, it's a miracle I survived.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・Hearing your story, I think.../・Because you're strong, Dunban-san ][XENO:del del=all ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Sometimes you have to depend[XENO:n ]
on other people for support.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]No one can do everything[XENO:n ]
on their own.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I agree. Strength in numbers.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]So I'm going to do whatever I can,[XENO:n ]
however I can, to support you all.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]If we work together, we can[XENO:n ]
make it through anything.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]I hear you, Shulk.[XENO:n ]
That is a sound plan.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・You can't fight alone/・The same goes for living ][XENO:del del=all ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]If I'd left Colony 9 on my own,[XENO:n ]
I never would've made it this far.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I think you're right, Shulk. And[XENO:n ]
I would have fared the same.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Having companions with us means[XENO:n ]
more than we realise sometimes.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]Yes, Rein and the others[XENO:n ]
have helped me many times.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]From now on, I want[XENO:n ]
to help them too.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Don't diminish your achievements.[XENO:n ]
You've done great things already.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]I can vouch for that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]That's nice of you to say, Dunban.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]But I feel like I've got a long way[XENO:n ]
to go. And I still need you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I know, Shulk.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]We all need each other in tough[XENO:n ]
times. I'm no different.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]So let's keep looking out for each[XENO:n ]
other, and we'll all stay safe.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]If it hadn't been for you guys,[XENO:n ]
I'd have been completely lost.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I know exactly what you mean.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]Alone we fall, but together[XENO:n ]
we can achieve anything.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I feel like all I ever achieve is[XENO:n ]
waiting for everyone to save me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]If anything I'd say the opposite[XENO:n ]
is true! But you know what?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You wouldn't be you if you weren't[XENO:n ]
fretting about these things.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Hmm.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]People say I'm a nice guy, but[XENO:n ]
I just do what comes naturally.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]What feels right.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]That is what makes you special.[XENO:n ]
Never lose that, Shulk.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Now, how about we rejoin[XENO:n ]
the others?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]OK, Dunban.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Thank you, by the way.[XENO:n ]
For everything.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Because I'm a hero, you mean?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I am no hero. I'm not strong[XENO:n ]
enough to be called that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT13 ]Huh?[XENO:n ]
You mean[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Dunban-san, who's known as a hero...?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Shulk, tell me something.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]What do you think of when you[XENO:n ]
talk about strength?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・Strength to overcome anything/・The heart to never give up ][XENO:del del=all ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]You're not wrong.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Without the brute force to repel[XENO:n ]
your enemies, you are never safe.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But is that the only meaning?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]What do you mean?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Dunban-san really is strong.[XENO:n ]
That's why you could protect us,[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]isn't it?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ]It's plenty. In fact, it might[XENO:n ]
even be too much.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]The truth about power is this:[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]All power corrupts, and those who[XENO:n ]
crave it will be corrupted by it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Corrupted? I don't understand.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]It was once explained to me[XENO:n ]
as I explain it to you now.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Those who crave ultimate power[XENO:n ]
lose all else in their pursuit of it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Oh...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]If you were to seek such power,[XENO:n ]
you might lose all of us.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And I'm sure you don't want that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]That's not right![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]You can't just cast aside Rein,[XENO:n ]
Dunban-san and the others![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]It's all right, Shulk.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I don't really think that would[XENO:n ]
happen to someone like you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Let's just call it food for thought.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Come on. Let's head back.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yeah, the others are waiting.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Thanks for the lesson, Dunban.[XENO:n ]
It was a real eye-opener![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Good answer, Shulk. I'd expect[XENO:n ]
nothing less from you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]The weak of heart eventually[XENO:n ]
lose all they have gained.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The only problem is, I don't know[XENO:n ]
how to get stronger in that sense.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I can't exactly do exercises for it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]You raise a valid point.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]It all depends on how firm[XENO:n ]
your convictions are.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]If you have firm convictions,[XENO:n ]
you are strong of heart.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]What kind of resolve do[XENO:n ]
you have, Dunban-san?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]During my days as a soldier, I did[XENO:n ]
anything I could to protect you all.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]So...I'd like to think so, I suppose.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Then that means you're strong[XENO:n ]
of heart. You said so yourself.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]So you're a hero after all.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Maybe, maybe not.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I guess that's not for me to say.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Well, you'll always be a hero[XENO:n ]
to me, Dunban.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Remember, this is just my[XENO:n ]
definition of strength.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]There must be countless other[XENO:n ]
possible definitions out there.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I bet everyone has their own.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Either way, I'm glad you told me.[XENO:n ]
It all makes sense to me somehow.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]True strength...it comes from[XENO:n ]
willpower, right?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]No need to be thanking me. You[XENO:n ]
figured that one out yourself.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]In truth, choosing not to fight[XENO:n ]
is the nobler path.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And that's something you realise[XENO:n ]
already, isn't it?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Anyway, I think it's time[XENO:n ]
to head back.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Good idea. Let's join the others.[XENO:n ]
They'll be waiting.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
